input.reply: Dealer busts on 25. You win 50 chips; bankroll 900.

value.result: You win with 20 (8-3-9) over the dealer's bust of 25 (6-J-9). You win 50 chips; bankroll 900.

turns.proseText: You Let's play Spanish 21. spanish-21 The dealer turns over the 5 for 15, which is below 17, so the dealer must draw. The dealer draws a 4 and makes 19. Your 16 loses, so you're out the 100 bet. Your bankroll stays at 900. Your 100 chip bet is down, which leaves 800 in your bankroll. You hold 6-8 for 14, and the dealer shows a 7 with one card face down. You can hit, stand, double or surrender. You Late surrender. You surrender. The dealer has no blackjack, so the surrender stands. You lose 50 chips and get 50 back. The dealer's hole card was a 9, which makes 16. Your bankroll is 850. Your 50 chip bet is down, which leaves 800 in your bankroll. You hold 8-3 for 11, and the dealer shows a 6 with one card face down. You can hit, stand, double or surrender. You Hit. You hit and draw a 9 of hearts. 8-3-9 makes 20, and the dealer still shows a 6. You can hit again or stand. You Stand. You stand on 20. The dealer turns over the jack for 16, which is below 17, so the dealer must draw. The dealer draws a 9 of clubs and busts with 25. You win 50 chips, and your bankroll is now 900.
